incidents.cause: The pilot's inability to maintain directional control during landing with a flat tire. Contributing to the accident was the failure of the left main landing gear tire for undetermined reasons.
The failure of the left side master brake cylinder that led to a loss of braking capability during landing rollout.  A contributing factor was the presence of a ditch next to the runway's end.
The pilot’s improper fuel system modification, which resulted in a loss of engine power due to fuel exhaustion.
The pilot’s loss of directional control while attempting to avoid a herd of antelope crossing the runway during the landing rollout.

The uncommanded retraction of the right main landing gear during taxi due to the failure of the landing gear extension system to move the right main gear upper side link into the locked position for undetermined reasons.
A loss of directional control while landing, which resulted in a runway excursion and landing gear collapse for reasons that could not be determined.
The pilot’s use of excessive braking which resulted in a nose-over.
A partial loss of engine power for undetermined reasons.
